sql_templates.description: Select stocks with insider buying or bulk deals in the last 5 sessions, confirmed by positive technical setups.
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_alerts AS (
    SELECT symbol, MAX(alert_date) AS latest_alert
    FROM signals.insider_alerts
    WHERE alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
    GROUP BY symbol
),
recent_bulk_deals AS (
    SELECT symbol, MAX(deal_date) AS latest_deal
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
    WHERE deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT ss.symbol, ss.technical_score, ss.trading_signal
FROM scores.stage_snapshots ss
INNER JOIN recent_alerts ra ON ss.symbol = ra.symbol
INNER JOIN recent_bulk_deals rb ON ss.symbol = rb.symbol
WHERE ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND ss.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
ORDER BY ss.technical_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Look for patterns of accumulation or distribution.', 'Focus on technical signals correlating with deal data.']
title: Insider Bulk Deal Signal Review Variant 0724
validation_rules: Ensure symbols are properly validated and belong to NSE.
Confirm that latest insider alerts and bulk deals are considered.
